checkpoints.title: First light
checkpoints.win: A real kit LED lights from an ESP32-controlled, protected fake battery.
checkpoints.firmware: router factory cp00: watchdog, explicit rail enable and latched reset; fixed battery links only; all future GPIO outputs LOW

tests.description: Measure purchased pogo/adapter/DevKit dimensions against the final drawing before soldering. Confirm the four kit pieces fit the selected rows without body collisions.
Unpowered: every rail >1kΩ to GND after capacitor charging; no accidental node/service connection.
With links open: 5V buck 4.90–5.04V; 3.3V buck 3.20–3.38V. Current-limited 12V supply, 100mA initially.
Each column: all six contacts <1Ω; every distinct pair of bare-module nodes >10MΩ with external harness isolated by test plugs.
NODE IDC odd pins map in order; even pins NC. SMART_RAW pins 1/3/5 map directly to the first three nodes (<1Ω).
1kΩ and 470Ω rail loads remain enabled; 330Ω or 100Ω load trips and remains latched. At 10mA: 5V_EDU 4.75–5.25V.
Sweep load: trip threshold must be >10.6mA and ≤12mA; record REF_TRIP and CURRENT_SENSE.
Scope current at a switched 100Ω load: source current cut off within 1ms, including frozen controller. Do not use UART timestamps as timing evidence.

Independent OV disconnects: sweep 5V/3V3 buck interfaces with consumers isolated; verify actual thresholds and strict contact peak ≤5.25V during a bounded 12V failed-buck step. Test both guards separately before connecting any IC.
Reset while overload persists must not release fault; power cycle, loss of heartbeat, USB unplug or held reset must leave rail off.

With power off, connect J_FIXED_BATTERY pin1 to A1 J_NODE pin3 (C2 +) and pin2 to J_NODE pin1 (C1 ground). Battery capsule: negative C1, positive C2; 1kΩ resistor C2–C3; LED A=C3/K=C4; three-gap kit jumper C4–C1.
No heartbeat/reset: student supply remains OFF. Explicit valid enable lights LED; disable extinguishes it. Reset, USB removal and frozen heartbeat return OFF without automatic restart.

links: Fixed battery +: C2; ground: C1. Matrix and diagnostic leads absent.

checkpoints.title: Electrical verification
checkpoints.win: Camera approval cannot override a failed electrical jumper test.
checkpoints.firmware: router factory cp01: fixed-pair ADC continuity test; GPIO4 SDA,16 SCL,25 STIM; stimulus OFF at boot and before energization

tests.description: Student supply OFF and positive fixed-battery lead unplugged. TEST_A→C4, TEST_B→C1; fit JP_RETURN only during test. Check stimulus current ≤0.34mA and educational contact voltages 0–5.25V.

Calibrate open, a known short and 1kΩ. Measure open stimulus voltage Vs with DMM; infer R=10k×V/(Vs−V), accounting for divider gain and input loading. Known short ≤20Ω; ≥100Ω rejected; 20–100Ω or saturated/unstable readings inconclusive and OFF. Compare inferred short with DMM continuity <1Ω.

Test the actual four-piece scene: correct C4–C1 kit jumper passes; one lifted contact and wrong-node placements fail. Include alternate paths through LED/resistor in calibration; no false pass through a component.
Simulated camera approval + failed/inconclusive electrical result keeps student supply OFF. Correction requires a fresh electrical test and separate enable request.
Before enable: stimulus OFF, JP_RETURN removed, test leads disconnected, fixed battery lead restored with power off. No automatic enable after a passing test.

links: Rail OFF; fixed positive lead open; probes C4/C1; JP_RETURN fitted for test only.
Before enable: stimulus OFF; JP_RETURN and probes removed; fixed positive lead restored.

checkpoints.win: The same kit circuit works with its battery assigned to another node pair.
checkpoints.firmware: router cp08: final matrix clear/route/precheck/enable; fixed battery harness unplugged

tests.description: MT supply 10.0–12.6V, digital high ≥3.3V, low ≤0.8V; reset and CS active high.
Sweep all X addresses and Y buses, proving the non-monotonic X address map. Banks share BUS2…BUS7.
Boot/reset/watchdog expiry: all crosspoints open. Disable rail, clear, configure, precheck, then enable; never configure live.
Scope full clear + 22-node configuration ≤50ms at the physical strobe pins; verify Ron at 0/2.5/5V.
Calibrate with 1kΩ 0.1%; distinguish open, short, 220Ω, 1kΩ and diode polarity; resistance error ≤10% after calibration.
Discharge 1000µF initially at 5V to <0.1V in 3s; keep total analog pin current ≤12mA.
Any short, unknown/invalid configuration or stale routing generation prevents rail enable; the precheck itself leaves rail off.
With all power off remove only the fixed battery patch leads; retain every soldered wire. Connect A1 NODE ribbon. In matrix mode no fixed source or fixture stimulus may remain connected.
Show a valid second battery position and corresponding kit arrangement. Invalid topology or stale routing generation cannot enable power.

instances.description: Fit SOIC/MSOP parts to numbered DIP adapters before installing them. Adapter pin numbers must preserve the IC numbering. Two 10-ohm current regulators replace the old 470-ohm output resistor. Scope verification of loop stability and short transients is required.

instances.title: Matrix board — 22 nodes, shared buses and test tools
instances.description: 12V_SYS must remain within 10.0–12.6V at the MT8816 pins. VSS and VEE are ground. 12mA limit applies to every analog pin, including a shared Y bus, not just an individual crosspoint.

instances.title: Pi buttons and PN532 SPI harness
instances.description: Pi uses its own rated USB supply. This harness shares ground, never a 5-V supply. PN532 carrier is Adafruit product 364; interface switches select SPI. Mount it with standoffs and use its labelled connector.

instances.title: Manual continuity fixture — no matrix required
instances.description: Connect TEST_A to A1 C4 and TEST_B to A1 C1 using removable test leads. Student supply stays OFF. Stimulus is limited by 10kΩ and isolated by a PhotoMOS switch. Unplug educational leads before ordinary operation.
